pages.text: Radiant Chests are a storage container with as many slots as a vanilla double chest in a single block. Each slot of a Radiant Chest can store up to 256 items instead of the stored item’s normal stack limit.$(br2)At the bottom of a Radiant Chest’s interface, you can give it a name to help keep your storage organized. Radiant Chests are also a light source.

Items stored in Radiant Chests appear on a $(l:arcanearchives:items/manifest)Manifest$(/l) as long as the Chest's chunk is loaded.$(br2)Using a $(l:arcanearchives:items/sceptermanipulation)Scepter of Manipulation$(/l) on a Radiant Chest while holding an item in the other hand allows you to label the chest with the held item. The item is not consumed.

To clear the item, sneak and activate the chest while holding the Scepter of Manipulation with your main hand and nothing in your off hand.$(br2)Using a $(l:arcanearchives:items/scepterrevelation)Scepter of Revelation$(/l) on a Radiant Chest will return the chest's name, and how many slots of its inventory are available.

In the lower right corner of a Radiant Chest's interface, you can choose how $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/brazierhoarding)Braziers of Hoarding$(/l) route items to the Chest. By default, a Brazier will be capable of routing any item to the chest; if the checkbox is ticked on, only items that already exist within the chest can be routed.
When monitored with a Redstone Comparator, a Radiant Chest ouptuts a signal based on how full it is (in total items, rather than number of slots filled).

Radiant Chests can be crafted by using a piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/rawquartz)Raw Radiant Quartz$(/l) on a chest while sneaking. Any items inside the chest will be imported, and if used on a double vanilla chest, both chests' inventories will be imported into the new Radiant Chest.$(br2)Radiant Chests can be crafted conventionally.

$()$(italic) I constructed a frame out of this crystalline substance. Items placed within the frame only seem to be visible—and, indeed, existent, if my instruments are to be believed— from certain angles of view. $()

$()$(italic) I tried to attach wooden panels to the frame to keep the contents within, but they too were subject to this strange spatial distortion. Reinforcing the wood with a lacquer ensorcelled with the $()Stalwart Oak Abjuration$()$(italic) seems to prevent the panels from being affected by these distortions. $()
